figurative_meaning_bn: আনন, বদন, কপাল থেকে চিবুক সম্পর্কিত মস্ত মুখ
figurative_meaning_en: Face or countenance, the entire face from forehead to chin
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার মুখমণ্ডল উজ্জ্বল হয়ে উঠেছে সাফল্যের আনন্দে।
example_sentences_in_english: Her face lit up with joy at the success.
She covered her face and cried.
note: This is a compound word rather than a proverbial idiom, commonly used in Bengali literature and speech to refer to the face.
